description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Freeze Plug Engine Block Kit
Provides all Necessary Plugs for the 1.3L / 8 Valve OR 1.6L 8V Engine Block
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
ENGINE BLOCK
Qty 5 – Plugs (Various Sizes)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1992 – 1998 All Models with 8V
GEO Tracker 1992 – 1998 All Models with 8V
